extracted.name: Lychee spritz
extracted.description: Raise a toast to warmer days with a glass of prosecco that has floral notes and a hint of tropical fruit thanks to lychee juice and rosewater
instruction_lines: Divide the lychee juice between four champagne flutes, then add ¼ tsp rosewater to each.
Divide the prosecco between the glasses, then top up with soda water. Drop a raspberry into each glass, then serve.
